description: Na₂MnPO₄F crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are two shorter (2.42 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.29 Å) and one longer (2.49 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.52 Å. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.42 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.54 Å. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.46 Å) Na-F bond length. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.50 Å. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.45 Å) Na-F bond length. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted MnO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.20 Å. There is one shorter (2.18 Å) and one longer (2.37 Å) Mn-F bond length. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted MnO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.20 Å. There is one shorter (2.20 Å) and one longer (2.35 Å) Mn-F bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MnO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-51°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MnO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-51°. There are three shorter (1.55 Å) and one longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂MnP tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₄Mn₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-72°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂MnP tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₄Mn₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-73°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Mn atoms to form FNa₄Mn₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂MnP tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₄Mn₂ octahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Mn atoms to form FNa₄Mn₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂MnP tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₄Mn₂ octahedra.
